title: Sum of the Top Scores
statement:
A game keeps every player's score in `scores` (repeats allowed, each entry counts). The prize pool is the **sum of the `k` highest scores**.

Return that sum.

hints.nudge: You never need all scores in order, only the best k. Which of the best k is the weakest?
hints.pattern: A min-heap holding at most k scores.
hints.pseudocode:
heap = empty min-heap
for each score: push it; if size > k: pop the smallest
return sum of the heap
hints.walkthrough: Sorting the whole list costs O(n log n). A min-heap of size k does better when k is small: push each score and, whenever the heap holds more than k scores, remove the smallest. The scores left are exactly the k largest. Add them up. Each heap operation costs O(log k).
